{{Quote|But even more important is the fact that with the Poln Major squad destroyed, the ''Whisperlike'' you retrieved at the spaceport was abandoned and therefore could be retrieved intact by Vaantaar and his warriors. Studying it will give us vital insights into Nuso Esva's technology and warship philosophy.|Thrawn|<ref name="Choices of One">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref>}}
'''''Whisperlike''-class starfighters''' were a type of starship used in [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]'s [[Eastern Fleet]]. It was possible to mount [[Caldorf VII interceptor missile]]s to ''Whisperlike''s, but the launchers were only able to fire forward. Because multiple species flew ''Whisperlike''s, the language used in their control boards could be changed using a translator card. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] destroyed a large number of ''Whisperlike''s during the [[Battle of the Poln system]]. In the aftermath of the battle [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] agent, [[Vaantaar]], acquired one ''Whisperlike'' for his master, who was able to use the ship to learn more about his enemies.<ref name="Choices of One" />
